title: Crispy Mediterranean Keto Pappardelle
description: A keto-friendly pasta dish with a focus on crispy, savory flavors and a mediterranean twist.
instructions: Cook the pappardelle according to the package instructions.
In a pan, heat the mediterranean over medium heat.
Add the vivid and crispy to the pan and sauté for 2-3 minutes.
Combine the cooked pappardelle and the vivid mixture in a bowl.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
